name: 地域限定保育士を学童支援員の要件に追加
summary: 現在、放課後児童支援員の要件の1つとして、保育士が定められています。この議案では、東京都が認定地方公共団体である場合、東京都の地域限定保育士もこの要件に含めます。また、条例中の児童福祉法の条項の引用を改め、公布日に施行します。

en.name: Adds regionally limited childcare workers to qualifications for after-school childcare support staff
en.official: Regarding the enactment of an ordinance to partially amend the Tama City Ordinance Concerning Standards for Facilities and Operation of After-School Child Development Services
en.summary: Currently, being a childcare worker is one of the qualifications for after-school childcare support staff. Under this bill, when the Tokyo Metropolitan Government is a certified local government, regionally limited childcare workers in Tokyo will also be included among those who meet this qualification. The bill also revises a citation to provisions of the Child Welfare Act in the ordinance and takes effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Includes regionally limited childcare workers among those who meet the qualification for childcare workers when the Tokyo Metropolitan Government is a certified local government
Revises the reference to Article 33-10 to refer to each item in paragraph 1
who: Regionally limited childcare workers in Tokyo
